source:
@@U03545@@
Rising from the breast of ocean! Lovely moon, your slaves are we, Ready to serve you eternally! 涅瑞伊得斯海仙女 and 特里同们: (As marvels of the sea.) Sing louder, sing, with shriller sound! Let the ocean’s depths rebound, With echo and summon all around! Eager to escape the waves, We took refuge in our caves, Hiding from the wind and weather, Yet your sweet song has drawn us hither. Behold us in our raptures here Decking ourselves with golden gear. Brooch and clasp and diadem, Rich with jewel and with gem. These you gave us, all of these, Treasure plucked from argosies, Ships you wrecked, that rotting lie, Lured to their destruction by You, the spirits of our bay.

@@U03547@@
Well we know that in the sea Fish live well and merrily, With no pain, no care, no wish! Stull, you throng so brisk and gay, We would like to know today If you're something more than fish. 涅瑞伊得斯海仙女 and 特里同们: We considered this before We came here to your rocky shore. Sisters, brothers, come! Let’s go The briefest journey just to show Conclusively just who we are, It won't take long, it isn’t far.
translation:
@@U03545@@
从海洋的胸膛升起！可爱的月亮，我们是您的奴隶，准备永远为您服务！ 涅瑞伊得斯海仙女和特里同们：（作为海洋的奇迹。） 大声唱，唱得更尖利！让海洋深处反弹，回响与召唤四面八方！渴望躲避海浪，我们躲进洞穴，躲避风吹雨打，但你甜美的歌声却把我们吸引到了这里。看看我们在这里用金色装备装饰自己的狂喜吧。胸针、扣环和王冠， 富有珠宝和宝石。这些你给了我们，所有这些，从商船上夺取的宝藏，你毁坏的船只，那个腐烂的谎言，被你引诱毁灭，我们海湾的灵魂。

@@U03547@@
我们知道，鱼儿在海里生活得幸福快乐，没有痛苦，没有牵挂，没有愿望！斯塔尔，你们聚集得如此活跃和快乐，我们今天想知道你们是否不仅仅是鱼。 涅瑞伊得斯海仙女和特里同们：我们在来到你们的岩石海岸之前就考虑过这一点。姐妹们、兄弟们，快来吧！让我们走最短暂的旅程，只是为了最终展示我们是谁，不会花很长时间，也不会很远。
